Preeminent

pree-EM-in-unt · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Preeminent is more distinguished than anyone else in a particular field; recognized as the foremost figure in standing or reputation.

Dr. Alvarez is widely regarded as the preeminent expert on coral reef restoration.

Worked Example

Though dozens of scholars study the topic, only one is considered the preeminent authority whose work every other researcher must cite.

Preeminent means more than just 'famous' or 'skilled' -- it means being recognized as the single best or foremost person in a specific field.

How Preeminent Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

foremost

foremost: most important or best-known; leading

unrivaled

unrivaled: having no equal; better than all others

Antonyms

mediocre

mediocre: of only average quality; not very good

obscure

obscure: not well known

How Strong Is It? — notable → preeminent → peerless

notable vs. preeminent

notable vs. preeminent: Notable simply means worth noticing or well-known -- it doesn't claim to be the single best.

peerless vs. preeminent

peerless vs. preeminent: Peerless goes even further, meaning literally without equal -- no one else even comes close.

Sort It Out

Now place each word on the right side of preeminent.

Build the Word

The pieces

prefix — pre-

prefix — pre-: before (Latin prae, 'before')

root — -eminent

root — -eminent: standing out, prominent (Latin eminere, 'to stand out')

Put it together

Put it together: Preeminent combines pre- ('before') with eminent ('standing out') -- literally 'standing out before all others,' someone recognized as the very best in their field.

Use the root in a new word: eminent

Use the root in a new word: eminent: You may already know the related word eminent, meaning famous and respected -- preeminent takes that idea one step further, to 'the most eminent of all.'

Root Check

Word Choice

Preeminent is reserved for genuine, widely recognized excellence -- it would sound odd, even sarcastic, to call something preeminent that most people have never heard of.
